surface_verification.justification: CI/workflow-infrastructure change; no web/UI/API/store/SSE surface touched. Verified instead via a native-Windows local run of the exact pytest invocation the new workflow runs, plus F0's fresh full-suite run on this tree; the live PR's own windows-latest Actions run is the remaining external, non-deterministic proof.

behaviors.behavior: windows-tests.yml runs shared/tests, shared/scripts/tests, and shared/scripts/tools/tests on windows-latest, on the same triggers ci.yml uses (pull_request/main, push/main, workflow_dispatch)
behaviors.evidence: spec-reviewer PASS (Stage 1) confirmed the trigger block and per-dir loop match the spec verbatim; the exact invocation was additionally run natively on this Windows host with all 3 dirs green

behaviors.behavior: all 4 currently Windows-gated tests (previously permanently skipped in CI) actually execute under the new job's filter (-m 'not slow and not cross_plugin')
behaviors.evidence: confirmed PASSED (not SKIPPED) in the native-Windows local run: test_atomic_write_windows_retry.py (8 cases), test_audit_phase_quality.py::test_strict_ancestor_windows_case_insensitive, test_playwright_setup_multiservice.py::test_setup_uses_resolved_executable_for_npm, 4 cases in test_host_resource_locking.py::test_windows_*

behaviors.behavior: ci.yml is not modified by this change
